next.reason: 1985: 'ACCESS MODE IS { SEQUENTIAL [ RELATIVE KEY IS data-name-1 ] / { RANDOM / DYNAMIC } RELATIVE KEY IS data-name-1 }'; 2023: '[ ORGANIZATION IS ] RELATIVE [ RELATIVE KEY IS data-name-7 ] ... ASSIGN ... USING data-name-1 ... LOCK MODE ... SHARING WITH'. 2023 lets RELATIVE KEY stand apart from the ACCESS clause, so it can be written with ACCESS omitted. It also adds ASSIGN USING, LOCK MODE and SHARING. RANDOM or DYNAMIC still require the key.
